name: api
description: This project was bootstrapped with Fastify-CLI.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --env-file=.env --test "test/auth/*.test.ts" "test/posts/*.test.ts" "test/profile/*.test.ts" "test/plugins/*.test.ts" "test/helpers/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'for port in 27018 27019; do if MONGODB_PORT=$port bash test/bin/mongo-docker.sh start; then export MONGODB_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:$port/devconnector_test; trap "MONGODB_PORT=$port bash test/bin/mongo-docker.sh stop" EXIT; npm run test:integration:run; exit $?; fi; done; exit 1'
scripts.test:integration:run: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node --env-file=.env.test --test "test/integration/auth.integration.test.ts" && node --env-file=.env.test --test "test/integration/posts.integration.test.ts" && node --env-file=.env.test --test "test/integration/profile.integration.test.ts"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && fastify start -l info -p 4000 dist/app.js --options
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "TypeScript,App" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm:watch:ts" "npm:dev:start"
